svg.title: Schur's theorem from a triangle
svg.desc: For a<b<d, triangle edges are coloured by the colours of b-a, d-b, and d-a. A monochromatic triangle yields same-colour positive integers x,y,z with x+y=z.

svg.desc: Figure labels: A monochromatic triangle encodes x + y = z; a; b; d; x = b − a; y = d − b; z = d − a; a < b < d; all three differences lie in [M − 1]
